en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a neoclassical building in the foreground with arcades and large arched windows, and a densely built hillside town rising behind it. At the top of the hill stands a prominent domed church. The image includes printed text along the left margin and at the bottom, and a modern website watermark "www.elia.org.gr". The word "Syros" appears in script near the lower left.
